raw_articles.title: Google Mantis: An Agentic Vulnerability Scanning Harness for Reducing False Positives
raw_articles.summary: Google has open-sourced Mantis, an AI-agent framework designed to automate the software vulnerability lifecycle, from identifying and validating vulnerabilities to reproducing and fixing them. Google says it developed Mantis to address the high rate of false positives and hallucinated vulnerabilities produced by conventional AI-powered code scanning. By Sergio De Simone

raw_articles.title: How Figma Uses AI Agents for Security
